newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates drop amid fresh arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates drop amid fresh arrivals.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates dropped on Wednesday amid rising supplies from the new 1997/98 (July-June) crop and are likely to weaken further in the next few sessions, dealers said.
They said the rising supply of fresh arrivals also subsided fears that the crop and stocks with ginning factories might have been damaged by heavy monsoon rains during the past few days.
In the kerb market, the new-crop NIAB-78 variety was traded in the range of 2,200 to ($54.16) to 2,175 rupees per maund (37.32 k.g), dealers said.
